standardDocuments.change: Defined HWPX reading levels R1-R4, added terminology lock, guarantee matrix, R4 minimum completion criteria, required wording, mandatory remediation plan, and the current remediation audit gate.
Added executable remediation audit for fixture manifest, package/XML inventory, unsupported element visibility, unsupported category summary, read-only payload, and source immutability.
Added regression coverage for the remediation audit and its generated machine/human reports.
Added server fixture corpus sync and server-side HWPX read remediation audit/runtime smoke to deployment verification.
Locked deployment verifier expectations for fixture corpus sync, remediation audit, and backend runtime smoke.
Linked the reading scope standard and added the current HWPX read claim boundary.
Recorded the current unsupported category output and next implementation priority.
Linked the reading scope standard from the app structure overview.

Added read-only paraPr definition extraction from Contents/header.xml for paragraph layout fields, inline lineBreak preservation as newline text in paragraph runs, charPr definition extraction for fontRef, ratio, relSz, bold, underline, and strikeout, and table/cell margin extraction for inMargin, outMargin, and cellMargin.
Exposed paragraph layout definitions, charPr text-style definitions, table/cell margin fields, and read-only cell paragraph payloads in the render payload without changing writer behavior.
Extended parse_char_pr_defs to preserve raw fontRef, ratio, relSz, underline, and strikeout child attributes while keeping existing preview booleans.
Added styles.charPrDefs plus table inMargin/outMargin and cell cellMargin fields to the Web Office document model.
Added regression coverage for align, autoSpacing, breakSetting, lineSpacing, margin, resolved tabPr/tabItem payload, text-style charPrDefs, table/cell margin fields, and read-only payload exposure.
Updated toolbar preview expectations so styles.charPrDefs may be exposed by default from the document model while explicit char_pr_defs remains supported.
Updated toolbar preview audit to use the current Web Office operational baseline and require default styles exposure.
Added regression coverage that hp:lineBreak is preserved as newline text in document paragraphs, runs, and read-only render payload cell paragraphs.
Classified Web Office test files into the test_support zone so the new-file gate can validate them deterministically.
Added regression coverage that new Web Office test files pass repo new-file classification.
Changed --temp-only commit guard execution to evaluate in memory without writing temporary report directories, avoiding host temp ACL failures.
